description:
• Brand introduction: Welcome to Tabasquishy™! 🌈 We are a dedicated studio specializing in handmade taba squishies, born from a mother’s passion for crafting with her 8-year-old child. Together, we cherish the joy of creating and want to share that happiness with everyone. 

• Product description: At Tabasquishy™, each squishy is thoughtfully crafted from eco-friendly, food-grade silicone (not edible) to ensure your safety and peace of mind. Our design team continuously explores innovative materials and concepts, transforming each product into not just a toy, but a work of art. Every Tabasquishy™ is a one-of-a-kind creation! 

• USP (Unique Selling Point): Safety First!: Our food-grade silicone is completely non-toxic and BPA-free, so it’s safe for everyone—even little ones who love to squeeze! It’s the same material used in kitchen tools, so you can trust it 100%. Super Soft & Squeezable: Our silicone squishies have that perfect squish factor—soft, smooth, and never sticky! They’re designed for endless fun and will always pop back into shape after every squish.
payout_period: Commission will be paid about 10 days after order receipt
